results.question: How many customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers LIMIT 500

results.question: How many customers are there in each country?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c GROUP BY c.country LIMIT 500

results.question: How many orders were cancelled?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the total net revenue?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS total_net_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 500

results.question: Which product category generates the most net revenue?
results.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS net_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Who are the top 5 customers by net revenue?
results.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS net_revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What was the net revenue for each month of 2025?
results.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS net_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the cancellation rate for each sales channel?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS sales_channel, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.channel LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the average order value?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 500

results.question: Which city has the most customers in India?
results.sql: SELECT c.city AS city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c WHERE c.country = 'India' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the gross profit for each product category?
results.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost) AS gross_profit FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category LIMIT 500

results.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS never_ordered_customers FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL LIMIT 500

results.question: What percentage of total net revenue comes from each sales channel?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS channel, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0))) OVER (), 2) AS revenue_pct FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel LIMIT 500

results.question: Which 3 products were returned in the highest quantities?
results.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_returned_qty FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'returned' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_returned_qty DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: On average, how many days pass between a customer's signup and their first completed order?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(first_comp.order_date, c.signup_date)) AS avg_days_to_first_order FROM customers AS c JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.order_date) AS order_date FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id) AS first_comp ON c.customer_id = first_comp.customer_id LIMIT 500

results.question: What was the month-over-month net revenue growth percentage in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(net_rev, 2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(CASE WHEN LAG(net_rev) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (net_rev - LAG(net_rev) OVER (ORDER BY month_start)) / LAG(net_rev) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) * 100 END, 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM (SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(o.order_date), ' ', MONTH(o.order_date), ' 1'), '%Y %c %e') AS month_start, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS net_rev FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month_start) AS monthly ORDER BY month_start LIMIT 500

results.question: What are the top 3 products by net revenue within each category?
results.sql: SELECT category, product_id, product_name, net_revenue FROM (SELECT p.category, p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS net_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) DESC) AS _w FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category, p.product_id, p.name LIMIT 500) AS _t WHERE _w <= 3

results.question: Which customer segment has the highest average order value?
results.sql: SELECT c.segment AS segment, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_order_value FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many orders contained more than 3 different products?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_gt_3_products FROM (SELECT oi.order_id FROM order_items AS oi GROUP BY oi.order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) > 3) AS sub LIMIT 500

results.question: What was the net revenue from UAE customers in the second half of 2025?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS net_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE c.country = 'UAE' AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31' LIMIT 500

results.question: How many customers signed up in 2025 and are active customers?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_2025_signups FROM customers AS c WHERE c.signup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed') LIMIT 500
